note: Real published specs for the 14 racing cars, with sources. Mass is road-ready (curb) weight; width is without mirrors where known. estimated: true marks a concept, show car or one-off whose figures are not all published; estimatedFields lists the figures that are estimates on any car (brake100To0M on all: makers rarely publish 100-0 km/h, so it comes from claims and road tests). src/physics/handling.js turns these into game physics, compressed so the field can race; the simulated figures next to the real ones are in PHYSICS.md. Gathered 2026-10-20.

av12.brakeBasis: estimated from the maker's 30 m claim (97-0 km/h) and road tests
av12.notes: mass is curb weight with fluids (1,525 kg dry); width 2.098 m is the maker's figure (2.03 m without mirrors on the wiki infobox)

furari-488.brakeBasis: estimated from road tests (488 family 100-0 about 31-32 m, Pista sharper)
furari-488.notes: mass is the maker's lightweight running order (1,280 kg dry); the wiki lists 1,500 kg curb

aston-martin-valk.engine: 6.5 L Cosworth V12, naturally aspirated + Rimac 160 hp electric motor
aston-martin-valk.brakeBasis: estimated: carbon-ceramic Alcon/Surface Transforms brakes, Michelin Cup 2 tyres
aston-martin-valk.notes: mass is an estimate of road-ready weight (the maker quotes 1,030 kg dry); the 402 km/h figure belongs to the AMR Pro track car, 354 km/h (220 mph) is the road car; the game's model is a Real Racing 3 Valkyrie from Sketchfab, scaled to the 4.5 m length

jaguarxkjss.engine: 1.6 L V6 turbo (F1 PU106B) + MGU-K, MGU-H and two front electric motors
jaguarxkjss.brakeBasis: estimated: carbon-ceramic brakes 398/380 mm, Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R
jaguarxkjss.notes: the 3D model replaced the Jaguar XKSS under this key; torque is not published (the maker calls it unmeasurable), 750 Nm is an estimate

mp1x.brakeBasis: estimated from the maker's 100-0 claim (about 30 m) and road tests
mp1x.notes: width 1.930 m without mirrors (2.161 m with)

mustang.engine: 5.0 L Coyote V8, naturally aspirated, front-mounted
mustang.brakeBasis: estimated from 60-0 mph road tests (about 105-110 ft)
mustang.notes: 420 lb-ft = 569 N.m; top speed is the electronic limiter (155 mph); 0-60 mph 4.4 s per the wiki; mass is an estimate of the GT with Performance Pack

bmw1.engine: 4.0 L M178 twin-turbo V8, front-mounted, 7-speed dual-clutch transaxle
bmw1.brakeBasis: estimated: GT4 race brakes (steel discs, ABS) on semi-slick tyres
bmw1.notes: the 3D model replaced the Veloce Aero shell under this key. Up to 510 PS (503 hp) and 600 N.m per Wikipedia, and the output is balance-of-performance dependent in series use; 0-100 in 3.6 s is Wikipedia's figure. The mass (the user's ~1,450 kg), top speed (gearing-limited), width, height and the length/wheelbase (4.59 m / 2.63 m, matching the model) are estimates, not maker-published GT4 figures

buggati.brakeBasis: estimated: Chiron-family carbon-ceramic brakes, about 31-33 m
buggati.notes: curb weight is the wiki's estimate; top speed is limited to 380 km/h

destrier.engine: 8.0 L W16 quad-turbo, mid-mounted (the Bolide's engine)
destrier.notes: a one-off on the Bolide's carbon monocoque: power (1,578 hp / 1,600 PS) and torque (1,850 N.m) are reported; Bugatti published no mass or performance, so mass follows the Bolide (1,450 kg), length and wheelbase follow the game model (5.07 m, 3.16 m; the Bolide is 4.835 m, 2.75 m), and the Destrier is about 1.0 m tall; performance is estimated

bentley-gt.notes: power, torque, 0-100 and top speed are Bentley's; sources disagree on weight (2,198-2,250 kg), 2,244 kg kept; width is without mirrors (2.187 m with)

blackbird.engine: 6.2 L V8, naturally aspirated, front-mid, 6-speed manual
blackbird.notes: Hennessey's targets: 800-850 hp (825 used), 0-60 mph 2.5 s, 220 mph (354 km/h), under 3,000 lb (1,360 kg); length and wheelbase follow the game model; the dimensions and torque are not published

porsche1.engine: 4.6 L V8, naturally aspirated, mid-mounted + two electric motors (one per axle)
porsche1.brakeBasis: estimated from road tests (60-0 mph in about 97 ft, carbon-ceramic brakes)
porsche1.notes: system figures: 652 kW (887 PS) and 1,280 N.m with both motors; the V8 alone makes 608 PS. Wikipedia lists a curb weight of 1,634-1,720 kg by build (the Weissach package is the light end), so 1,675 kg is a mid estimate. The game's model is a Sketchfab 918 Spyder with the Weissach rear wing

huracan.brakeBasis: the maker's claim (100-0 km/h in 30 m); a road-test figure would be 31-32 m
huracan.notes: 640 PS (471 kW) at 8,000 rpm and 565 N.m at 6,500 rpm, rear-wheel drive with rear-wheel steering. Mass is the maker's 1,339 kg dry plus about 90 kg of fluids (road-ready); width is without mirrors (2.236 m with); the maker's press sheet gives 4,549 mm for the length, other listings 4,547 mm

laferrari.engine: 6.3 L V12, naturally aspirated, mid-mounted + HY-KERS electric motor
laferrari.brakeBasis: estimated from the maker's claims and road tests (about 30 m)
laferrari.notes: 963 PS combined: 800 PS from the V12 (700 N.m) plus 163 PS from the 120 kW motor, 900 N.m combined; the maker claims about 1,255 kg dry, the wiki lists a 1,585 kg kerb weight, so the mass is the listed kerb figure and an estimate; top speed is 'in excess of 350 km/h'

upgrades.note: Physical effects only; costs and currency belong to the UI. Applied by physics/handling.js setUpgrades(key, {engine, tyres, brakes}) on top of the base car; level 0 is stock. Arrays are the effect at levels 1, 2, 3.

engine.label: Engine / motors
engine.applies: ICE and hybrid: engine tune, turbos, ECU, intake; EV: inverter and motor tune, cooling
engine.effect: more power at every speed; top speed follows from the unchanged drag (about +1.6%, +3.2%, +5%)

tyres.label: Tyres
tyres.effect: more peak cornering, traction and braking grip, and more of it kept on a wet road (added to the fraction of dry grip kept)

brakes.label: Brakes
brakes.applies: discs, pads and cooling, all cars
brakes.effect: more brake torque, which lifts the rear brakes toward the tyre limit
